items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I made a trip with Harold Dajon on the SS Dixie... I used to fight the parts with Harold Dajon... Harold Dajon would teach both of us.

ctx.x: Did you learn to read right away when you started in music?
No, no. I'll tell you what started me to take lessons. I made a trip with Harold Dajon on the SS Dixie. That's around 1929 or 30, I'd say. I traveled on the boat until about 32.
